name: ZWA Gold Reference Unit
description: A synthetic experimental unit with a gold market reference. It conveys no claim on physical gold.
underlyingRights: No legal or beneficial interest in gold, vault inventory, or redemption rights.
denomination: ZEC settlement; XAU/USD reference is indicative
transferRestrictions: Enforced by ZWA matcher for participating trades; external ZSA transfers are outside this policy
offerTerms: Fresh seller-approved native ZEC quote and separate buyer approval required
redemptionTerms: No redemption for gold or cash
pricingSource: Pyth Core XAU/USD over HTTPS when configured and fresh; seller ZEC quote for execution

name: ZWA Treasury-Style Unit
description: A synthetic fixed-income-style unit with an issuer NAV reference. It is not a Treasury security.
underlyingRights: No claim on a Treasury bill, bond, fund, coupon, or government obligation.
denomination: ZEC settlement; issuer USD NAV is indicative
transferRestrictions: Enforced by ZWA matcher for participating trades; external ZSA transfers are outside this policy
offerTerms: Issuer NAV is reference only; execution requires fresh seller-approved native ZEC quote
redemptionTerms: No bond maturity payment or redemption
pricingSource: Operator-pinned issuer NAV statement when available; seller ZEC quote for execution

name: ZWA Credit Participation Unit
description: A synthetic private-credit-style participation used to test negotiated settlement.
underlyingRights: No enforceable loan, receivable, collateral, interest, or repayment right.
transferRestrictions: Enforced by ZWA matcher for participating trades; external ZSA transfers are outside this policy
offerTerms: Negotiated seller quote with short expiry; independent buyer and seller wallet approval
pricingSource: Authenticated local seller offer only; no live spot or appraisal claim
